info.description:
Auto-generated from `php artisan route:list --json --path=api`.

Run folder `00 Smoke Run` first. It logs in with `admin@abctransport.com / password`, saves `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `tenantId`, then checks safe endpoints.

Authenticated requests use Postman Bearer Auth with token `{{accessToken}}` and also include an explicit `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` header. The exporter pre-fills `accessToken` when `localhost:8080` is reachable.

All `01 API Reference / ...` folders include sample bodies for POST/PUT/PATCH requests and reusable collection variables.
